lines.t: Verse 1
When the road is dark and I can’t see the way,
When my strength feels small and my courage fades,
I remember the mercy You showed to me,
How Your love reached down and set me free.
You called my name, You lifted my eyes,
Showed me truth I could never deny,
Now every step that I take will say:
I belong to You always.
Chorus
I'm never gonna turn away,
I'm never gonna follow another.
I'm never gonna forget the day
I realized You'd love me forever.
My heart is with You, YahuShua,
Forever I will stay true.
Through every storm, through every day,
My life will follow You.
Verse 2
Sometimes I stumble, sometimes I fall,
And I know I haven’t given my all.
When Your Spirit shows me where I’ve gone wrong,
I come to You with tears falling strong.
But You meet me there with mercy and grace,
Not turning away from my seeking face.
You correct my heart with the love You give,
And teach me again how to live.
Bridge
No shadow, no doubt,
No fear can pull me away,
Your love is the anchor
That will forever stay.
Final Chorus
I'm never gonna turn away,
I'm never gonna follow another.
I'm never gonna forget the day
I realized You'd love me forever.
My heart is with You, YahuShua,
Forever I will stay true.
For all my life and endlessly,
My heart belongs to You.
